about_the_game: Everybody Loves Cake is a roguelike where you fight for your life and grow stronger not by leveling up or collecting items, but by dying. Forget grinding, forget farming, forget leveling, just fight until every last enemy falls while you cling to life. And if you heal yourself, be careful not to overdo it, because your buffs will instantly reset once you're fully recovered.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains explicit depictions of cartoon genitalia, including erect penises and nipples exaggerated to unusual sizes. It also includes references to drug use, sexually transmitted diseases (STDs), and frequent strong language.
